{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sirens of Lowick''' were a group of fabled creatures or individuals probably from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]]. They were considered interstellar vermin by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] who encountered them while traveling on cargo freighters carrying special cargo in the [[Stenness Node]].
